passages.note: Heaton is in the Yea column of the House third-reading roll call on HJR 3, a single-subject marriage resolution, on a divided 57-40 vote.

passages.provision_quote: Section 38. Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana.
passages.note: The engrossed House text adds one operative constitutional section defining marriage as one man and one woman and barring any other marriage from being valid or recognized in Indiana.
The bill-details page lists Heaton as a co-author of the engrossed resolution, a second own act on the same instrument.
passages.actor_quote: Co-Authored by: Rep. Timothy Wesco, Rep. Wes Culver, Rep. Rhonda Rhoads, Rep. Robert Heaton, Rep. Don Lehe, Rep. Matthew Lehman, Rep. Randall Frye.

rows.reasoning: Heaton co-authored HJR 3 (2014) and voted Yea on its third reading, a single-subject constitutional amendment whose only operative section reads "Section 38. Only a marriage between one (1) man and one (1) woman shall be valid or recognized as a marriage in Indiana." That text both defines marriage as one man and one woman and bars any same-sex marriage from being valid or recognized, matching the rung "Make same-sex marriage illegal and define marriage as only between one man and one woman." The rung "Recognize civil unions for same-sex couples, but reserve marriage for opposite-sex couples" is excluded because the measure recognizes no civil union.
